purpose: Track curriculum-mapping depth separately from structural intelligence coverage.

definitions.reference_complete: Every concept profile in the domain points to at least one relevant curriculum/framework research source.
definitions.framework_mapped: The concept has a defensible placement or explicit non-placement in China 2022, England, and the Common Core comparison baseline, or is mapped as a cross-cutting practice rather than a grade standard.
definitions.fully_verified: All surfaced system-specific claims have direct authoritative locators at the required granularity.
definitions.pep_sequence_verified: Exact current PEP 12th-series grade/semester/unit placement is directly verified.
